{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scimitar Mark II Assault Bomber''' was a next generation model of the [[Scimitar assault bomber]].

It was generally similar to its [[Scimitar assault bomber|predecessor]], other than improved [[Ion engine/Legends|ion]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines. The speed was increased to a normal atmospheric cruising speed to 1,150 kilometers per hour. The dive bombing speed was also increased, with the top speed of 1,250 kilometers per hour.
